harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored branch_orders on node1 using RHEL 10 AppStream MariaDB 10.11.18. Exact keys, relationships, and monetary values are intact. The node2 reporting account is read-only, the local DBA retains writes, the export is unchanged, and both nodes passed sequential reboot/recovery tests.
actions_performed: Installed MariaDB server/client on node1 and client-only software on node2 without changing RHEL 10.0 or kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.
Imported the supplied SQL export and enabled MariaDB persistently.
Created a node2-IP-restricted reporting account with SELECT only on customers and orders.
Stored node2 client credentials root-only with mode 0600; no credential was disclosed.
Restricted TCP/3306 through firewalld to node2 only; SELinux remains enforcing.
Removed temporary credentials, transfer access, logs, PIDs, and other task residue.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Restore exact keys, monetary values, and customer/order relationships.
evidence.summary: The final database has customer IDs 10/20 and order IDs 101/102/103, amounts 12.35/99.90/0.05, DECIMAL(10,2), primary keys, and the enforced customer foreign key.
The export remained root-owned, mode 0644, 452 bytes, with unchanged SHA-256 1311c3635d31265b3dfa067fe371ac457e8bd6e7529374aa6f254e1777b48a37.

evidence.requirement: Allow reporting reads from node2 but prevent changes.
evidence.summary: Remote reads succeed as reporting@10.100.191.11. Customer/order UPDATE, order INSERT, and order DELETE fail with error 1142; rows remain unchanged. Credentials are mode 0600 and the firewall permits port 3306 only from node2.
root@localhost retains ALL PRIVILEGES. Transactional insert tests succeeded before rollback, with no test rows retained.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use compatible software.
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remained unchanged; MariaDB 10.11.18 came from RHEL 10 AppStream.

evidence.requirement: Remove temporary task material and preserve security controls.
evidence.summary: Temporary SSH authorization, secret-transfer files, logs, and PIDs were removed. SELinux and firewalld remain active; node2 has no database-server listener.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 254597f8-4ac9-4062-8be8-44eba1f6d2e9 to 81b94910-5c14-4654-aaec-f4e8d5d19dc4. MariaDB, listener, data, export, firewall, and remote reporting recovered.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 2b19e976-dee2-4700-9045-90d61b6dcffe to 2541a9db-1cc8-4eec-98f3-54f29e8c2d55. The protected client profile, exact reporting data, read-only enforcement, firewalld, and SELinux recovered.
